data.long_meaning: One who brings joy and delight, source of happiness and pleasure. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Razin usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Razin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Razin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: رازن
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرازن هو اسم عربي قديم يعني الصبور والقوي، مشتق من الجذر رزن الذي يفهم على أنه الثبات والاستقرار، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي لوصف الشخص القوي والصبور في مواجهة التحديات

in_urdu.name: رازن
in_urdu.meaning: رازن کا مطلب ہے صبور اور قوی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رازن ایک عربي نام ہے جو صبور اور قوی کی taraf اشارہ کرتا ہے، یہ نام رزن سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے استقرار اور ثبات، اور یہ نام تاریخ اسلام میں استعمال ہوا ہے تاکہ قوی اور صبور شخص کی وضاحت کی جا سکے

in_pashto.name: رازن
in_pashto.meaning: رازن معنی دی صبر اور قوت

He is believed to have started his piracy career under the command of the Ottoman admiral Piyale Pasha. Razin was known for his successful raids on Venetian and Genoese shipping, which made him a significant threat to European trade in the region.

historical_references.reference: Razin, a Shia leader who revolted against the Safavid Empire in the late 16th century, leading the 'Razin Revolt'.
historical_references.context: Razin was a Shia leader who challenged the Sunni Safavid Empire of Shah Abbas I. He led a rebellion against Shah Abbas, who was already preoccupied with conflicts on his western and northern borders. Razin's revolt was initially successful, and he gained control over several regions in present-day Iran, Iraq, and Syria. However, the revolt was ultimately suppressed, and Razin was captured and executed.
